items.model_rationale: I read the Appendix A native image. The table header reads '(متر فوق منسوب الأرض الطبيعية)' (metres above natural ground level). Note 2 says height is measured from natural ground level before grading and filling. Note 1 lists permanent and temporary structures including stacks, cranes and construction equipment. These conflict with the English Appendix B. The zone heights (25 and 40) and the 30 m lighting threshold match in both versions.

payload.what_is_unsupported: The op types (replace_text, annotate, etc.) act on units as they stand at the previous stage (ADD-02). Both Table 5-1 versions are first issued by ADD-03 and are not_issued at ADD-02, so no op can record that one ADD-03 unit prevails over another. A person must decide how the register records that the Arabic governs (for example the datum and scope of the height limits) and whether a discrepancy issue or clarification should be raised.
payload.why: AppB/para1 makes the Arabic Table 5-1 (Appendix A image) govern over the English translation at Appendix B ('The Arabic text of Table 5-1 at Appendix A governs.'). The two versions differ materially: the English note (2) and column header use finished ground level after grading and filling, while the Arabic note 2 and header use natural ground level before grading and filling (منسوب الأرض الطبيعية قبل أعمال التسوية والردم). The English note (1) covers permanent structures including stacks, while the Arabic note 1 covers permanent and temporary structures including cranes and construction equipment. Anything read from the English T5-1 rows would misstate the governing limits. This is not no_effect, because the precedence words decide which text binds.

statements.text: The English Appendix B note (2) measures height from finished ground level after grading and filling; the Arabic Appendix A note 2 measures it from natural ground level before grading and filling (منسوب الأرض الطبيعية قبل أعمال التسوية والردم). The English note (1) covers permanent structures including stacks; the Arabic note 1 covers permanent and temporary structures including stacks, cranes and construction equipment.

Under AppB/para1 the Arabic Table 5-1 (Appendix A) prevails where the English translation (ADD-03:T5-1 rows and notes) differs, so the height datum and the scope of the limits must be taken from the Arabic: natural ground level before grading and filling, and temporary structures and cranes included. The amendment op types cannot record precedence between two units both issued by this Addendum.
